news.title: Bitcoin ETF Sellers Show No Mercy: BlackRock Leads $582M Bitcoin ETF Exodus as BTC Hits New Lows
news.body: The bleeding this November appears relentless, producing yet another consecutive red day for crypto. US spot Bitcoin ETFs lost a net $582 million on Thursday, November 19, their third straight day of outflows, and BTC USD slipped under $62,000. BlackRock’s iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) accounted for $541 million of that, its largest single-day outflow since..
